Preconditions: Verified active test account
Procedure: Submit correct and incorrect credentials
Expected Result: Correct credentials grant access; incorrect credentials are rejected.

Preconditions: Test account and matching Google email
Procedure: Sign in with Google using the same normalized email
Expected Result: The same member record is used; no separate duplicate account is created.

Preconditions: Unsupported email account
Procedure: Attempt registration and Google access
Expected Result: Unsupported institutional domain is rejected.

Preconditions: Eligible account and working test mail delivery
Procedure: Request reset; open link; set a new password
Expected Result: Password changes only with a valid link; the old password no longer works.

Preconditions: Expired, altered, or consumed token
Procedure: Attempt a password reset with each token
Expected Result: Each invalid reset is rejected without another password change.

Preconditions: New incomplete test account
Procedure: Submit missing bank fields, then complete dummy testing data
Expected Result: Required fields are enforced; the test-data note is visible.

Preconditions: Two member accounts and a harmless test image
Procedure: Upload avatar; open own and other-user profile
Expected Result: The saved avatar is shown; private fields are not exposed to unrelated members.

Preconditions: Unselected, selected, and completed job contexts
Procedure: Compare profile responses as different viewers
Expected Result: Contact email is disclosed only under the implemented counterpart/owner/admin rules.

Preconditions: Authenticated hirer with other required fields complete
Procedure: Create a job leaving supplementary notes blank
Expected Result: The optional notes field does not block submission.

Preconditions: Pending job/service and administrator
Procedure: Inspect visibility before and after approval/rejection
Expected Result: Only the appropriate approved/active listings become discoverable.

Preconditions: Accounts with own and others’ eligible posts
Procedure: Open hirer and worker discovery pages
Expected Result: Own posts are excluded while eligible posts from other accounts remain visible.

Preconditions: Approved open job and two worker accounts
Procedure: Apply, inspect applicants, and select one worker
Expected Result: The selected worker is saved; unrelated users cannot perform selection.

Preconditions: Active service post with known capacity
Procedure: Submit requests and attempt acceptance beyond capacity
Expected Result: Acceptance respects current availability/capacity and gives an appropriate error otherwise.

Preconditions: Acceptable pending service request
Procedure: Accept the request, then repeat the action
Expected Result: Only one resulting job is linked to the accepted request.

Preconditions: Stripe test keys/provider setup and an eligible job
Procedure: Complete checkout and inspect verified server payment state
Expected Result: The appropriate paid/held state follows server confirmation rather than the URL alone.

Preconditions: Eligible unpaid job
Procedure: Cancel checkout or revisit a success-looking return URL without payment
Expected Result: The application does not falsely mark the payment as paid and offers a usable exit.

Preconditions: Assigned jobs with unpaid and eligible paid states
Procedure: Attempt to start each job as assigned and unrelated users
Expected Result: Only an authorized worker on an eligible job can advance the state.

Preconditions: In-progress paid test job
Procedure: Upload evidence; inspect as hirer; confirm completion
Expected Result: Evidence and confirmation are persisted and visible only to authorized viewers.

Preconditions: Applicable prototype payout record and admin
Procedure: Record permitted payout evidence and inspect resulting state
Expected Result: Only the authorized operation advances the payout record; no live transfer is inferred.

Preconditions: Eligible refund flow and harmless test images
Procedure: Add/remove a selected image, submit request, and review as admin
Expected Result: Removed images are excluded from submission; request and completed refund remain distinct.

Preconditions: Completed eligible job
Procedure: Submit a review, repeat it, and try as an unrelated user
Expected Result: Only permitted participant/direction is accepted and duplicates are rejected.

Preconditions: Stored inside/outside-radius coordinates and connection control
Procedure: Trigger an eligible notification; disconnect/reconnect recipient
Expected Result: Recipients and persisted/read/delivery behavior match the defined rules; record actual timing.

Preconditions: Ordinary member and administrator sessions
Procedure: Attempt user/report/SOS administrative operations
Expected Result: Member access is rejected and authorized admin actions follow the implemented workflow.

Preconditions: Member and administrator sessions
Procedure: Submit comment; list as admin; mark read; attempt member listing
Expected Result: Comment is stored separately from reviews; administrative access is enforced.

Preconditions: Mobile and desktop browsers with internal/direct-entry history
Procedure: Exercise job/payment navigation, Back/Forward, return, reload, and explicit exit
Expected Result: Navigation reaches a meaningful permitted destination and does not duplicate state changes.

Preconditions: 320/390/768/1440-pixel viewports and keyboard
Procedure: Traverse focus, open/close dialogs, inspect forms and status text
Expected Result: Essential actions remain reachable, focus visible, and content usable; record observed issues.
